root_causes.evidence: Kernel/guard are deterministic scripts that decide/record only when explicitly invoked; chat connector calls can occur without passing through them.
Execution exceeded governance limits (checkpoint_call 6 / hard cap 8 in DEK v3, at-most-one external effect in Chat Non-Blocking Gate) because no live guard state wrapped each connector call.
Manifest-first policy declares heavy_work_sync_call_max_seconds=5, but repository code cannot interrupt a connector call once the platform tool invocation is in flight.
Allowed sequence requires persist terminal/running state then exit; execution continued into runner/billing discovery.
CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF still reports DURABLE_RUNNER_ACCESSIBLE_CARRIER_BRIDGE_MISSING although Drive First Gate 11/11 is now durably verified.

missing_corrections: MANDATORY_TOOL_CALL_ENVELOPE: every external call must consult and update a durable call-budget/anti-freeze state before and after execution.
CHECKPOINT_AND_EXIT_ENFORCEMENT: once checkpoint barrier or terminal durable delta is reached, no new diagnostic/tool route may start in the same invocation.
TIMEOUT_ISOLATION: potentially blocking work must be launched outside chat as an adoptable job; chat may perform at most one bounded status read.
ATOMIC_POINTER_ADVANCE: after a blocker is resolved, CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF/CWS execution checkpoint must CAS-advance in the same durable commit bundle.
ROUTE_CLASSIFICATION: Drive uploads/downloads/materializations and runner launches must be tagged as effects/expensive units instead of unmetered helper calls.
RUNTIME_ENFORCEMENT_TEST: add an integration/chaos test that simulates a connector call hanging and proves checkpoint/exit rather than continued orchestration.
